_meta.rationale: Vercel ships Geist; the registry does not yet carry a Geist row, so lookup() returns DEFAULT_FREE_ALTERNATIVE (brand_font_name='Default free type system', free_alternative='Inter'). The disclosure aside surfaces that explicit default state per the library_web_fonts contract; the spec asserts the documented fallback, not a Geist-specific mapping that does not exist in source-of-truth. Negative assertion uses slug=vercel strip targets.
gaps: Geist is not in BRAND_FONT_REGISTRY. Adding a 'geist' row would tighten the disclosure assertions to a brand-font-name 'Geist'. Logged as a Phase 1 registry-extension item, not a Phase 4 spec fabrication.
Vercel is not in fidelity_targets.yml; gate will report MISSING_REFERENCE for vercel tuples until captures + targets entries land.

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('h1.a-display-1'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()

(() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['vercel.com/logo', 'vercel-logo', 'vercel-triangle', '/logo.svg', '/wordmark.svg', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-body'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()
